top_signals.title: Stocks Rebound on Strong SpaceX Results; AI Bubble Dispute; Tech Earnings on Deck
top_signals.summary: US equity futures rise as SpaceX's quarterly earnings and Elon Musk's remarks on a potential SpaceX-Tesla merger boost investor confidence. Citadel's Ken Griffin warns that investors are "almost certainly" in an AI bubble, while Deutsche Bank's Christian Sewing says he doesn't see one. Jensen Huang speaks at the Nvidia GTC event in Berlin. Tesla, Meta, and IBM are set to report earnings. Kallum Pickering of Peel Hunt joins "Bloomberg Brief" on the risks around debt-financed growth. Bernard Mensah, President of Bank of America International joins Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua for an exclusive conversation at the Berlin Global Dialogue.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
